entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return these useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I apologize for the wait. To get started, could I have your name and order number?
The name is Tom Wilson, order number is VF88602. Don't waste my time, just process the return. I want a full refund, and I want it now.

Thank you for that, Tom. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes purchased 73 days ago. I understand you're frustrated. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you kidding me? A fault or a preference? The fault is that your shoes are garbage! I've tried everything, but they've given me the worst blisters of my life. I can't even get through a short ride. And the cleats system is impossible to align properly.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters and that you're having trouble with the cleats. That sounds incredibly uncomfortable and is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.

Save the apologies. I'm not interested in troubleshooting. I'm interested in a refund. Are you going to give me one or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm one click away from leaving a review on every single cycling forum about this.

That won't be necessary, Tom. Let me just confirm our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've checked your purchase date. Since the cycling shoes were delivered 73 days ago, they are well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Wait, really? So you'll take them back? Even after all this time?
Yes, absolutely. I can authorize this return for a full refund right now. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label. Just package the shoes in their original box and drop them off at any post office.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... good. I appreciate that. I was expecting a huge fight.
Not at all. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. A prepaid label, you said? Okay, I see it in my inbox now. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Tom. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
